passages.title: The Ancient Lizard Attacks
passages.text:
A wave of foam rises to starboard. Just beneath the surface, you glimpse the head of an enormous sea lizard.
Mac clutches the gunwale, staring into the acrid foam with barely concealed fear.
"It has found us already..."
The beast slams its full weight into the side of the ship, throwing Mac onto the deck. Laurent spins the wheel to port, and the Manticore lets out a metallic groan as she rights herself.
Ahead of you, a scaly tail as wide as a quarter of the deck lashes the sea like an impatient cat.
"It's playing with us," Mac growls.
"What is it?" Laurent asks.
"An ancient creature called the Hectakron. It hates the gods... and anyone who tries to wake them. It'll sink us if it can."
An ancient monster called the Hectakron is trying to prevent you from awakening the gods.
COMBAT 46 (Level 10)
Failure:
• Brutal mode: go to D1.7.
• Normal mode: go to 1.1 and restore all crew members to full health.
Then discard 6 Event cards after creating the new deck. (Go to paragraph 1.1.)

passages.title: The Hectakron Dives Again
passages.text:
The Hectakron plunges back into the depths.
Mac remains on the bridge, her eyes fixed on the sea.
"It'll come back," she whispers. "And next time, it won't stop until we're on the bottom."
You have defeated the Hectakron... for now.

passages.title: The Mythans Attack
passages.text:
The silhouette of a ship appears on the blood-red horizon.
It approaches swiftly, sails snapping in the wind, and soon the battle cry of its crew rings out: a horde of bull-headed creatures whose eyes glow like embers.
The Mythans have found you!
Their ship strikes the Manticore's hull, and massive figures leap onto the deck.
A Mythan chief, twice the size of the others, jumps over the gunwale.
His four arms wield a rusty pike, a curved saber, a trident, and a flail.
"You will not awaken Orfash!" he thunders.
"We will kill you and cast your bones into the deepest abyss!"
The Mythans have been hunting you since your escape, and they have finally found you.

passages.text:

"Tell me, great chief, is your creator Orfash so hated by his children? Why refuse to let him awaken?"

"We are not his children, but his prisoners! While Orfash sleeps, we are free of his chains and powerful among all the creatures of land and sea. We will not tolerate your interference!"
The Mythans want Orfash to remain asleep so that they can rule freely.
Gain 2 XP. Remove 1 low morale.

passages.title: Wayfinder Calms the Mythans
passages.text:
Wayfinder steps forward and raises his hands.
"Do not be afraid, my brothers. We will never again be subject to the will of the gods. These humans are helping me strip them of their power and make them mortal forever. When Orfash awakens, he will no longer have any hold over you."
One of the Mythans growls:
"Why should we believe you?"
"Because I am one of you," Wayfinder replies. "And above all, because my words are true. You have a choice. I give it to you freely."
The Mythans exchange a glance, then decide to let you go.
Wayfinder succeeds in convincing them.

passages.title: The Riddle of the Voice in the Darkness
passages.text:
The air is warm and familiar, and the smell of fried fish drifts through the darkness, which is strange, because it is as black as the bottom of a well.
A voice echoes nearby, muttering a little refrain:
"The sea is for fish; the sky is for birds; the head is for thoughts; the mouth is for..."
The silence that follows tells you that you must provide the answer.
A voice asks you a riddle:
"The sea is for fish, the sky is for birds, the head is for thoughts, the mouth is for..."
Write your answer on a piece of paper.
Go to paragraph 33.

passages.title: The talking tree and the promise of secrecy
passages.text:
As you raise the ax, the tree quivers.
Its bark deforms, forming a face: two dark eyes, plump cheeks, a round, thick mouth.
—Stop! Please ! If you cut the flower, I will die!
You lower the axe, surprised by the voice of the trunk.
Rafael stutters:
— He... he speaks?
The tree shakes its wrinkled branches, making its leaves tremble like a peacock.
— Of course I'm talking!
—Is there anywhere else where you could find a similar flower? Mac asks, soothingly.
“Only by cutting down another tree like me,” he replies.
I have been standing here for centuries. Others before you came for this flower, and I can tell you: none wanted it for good. It only brings death to those who take it.
Audrie intervenes, her voice full of hope:
— Gliglion told us she could bring back her love.
Isn't there a way without killing you?
The tree fixes the ax in your hand.
—You look like brave humans.
Throw this ax into the sea so I can see it disappear.
Then come back here, and I'll tell you a secret.
The animated tree begs you not to cut the flower — otherwise it will die.
He promises to tell you a secret if you throw your ax into the sea.

→ Go to paragraph 38
B. Throw the ax into the sea.

An iron gate blocks the entrance to a mountainous cavern.
It would take colossal power to cross it.

passages.title: The hidden altar and the sea serpent
passages.text:
The cannon shot shatters the door.
- Amazing ! Where does this weapon get all this power? shouts Laurent.
You board the annex and enter a vast cavern.
In dark, still water, a tiny sea snake circles.
As you approach, he steps forward, curious, to observe you with his round eyes.
— Can we keep it? Rafael asks, stroking the creature's scaly head.
“No,” you respond dryly.
Near the back of the cavern, you discover an ancient altar.
An offering cup contains gold and a small statue.
An altar contains a golden cup and a statuette.
Obtain: 1 artifact, 7 coins.
As you return to the Manticore, the small sea serpent follows you, swimming behind the tender.
— Look! He wants to come with us, said Rafael, tossing him a piece of biscuit from the emergency rations.
Once on the ship, the little creature circles the hull in happy circles.
—What are we going to call it? Rafael asks, tossing another cookie.
You open your mouth to respond when the sea suddenly boils.
Something is moving beneath the surface.
In an instant, the water explodes: a gigantic sea serpent springs forth, engulfs the little one with a snap of its jaws - sucking it in like spaghetti - before diving back into the depths, leaving only agitated swirls behind it.
Rafael remains frozen, his eye twitching, before silently returning to his post below deck.
A small sea snake was following you, but it was devoured.
Obtain: 1 low morale, 2 XP

→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Laurent’s regrets
passages.text:
“I'm not going to sleep peacefully, Captain, thinking about that door and what was behind it,” said Laurent, gripping the helm.
“You’ll get over it,” Gloria replies, sipping her coffee.
Laurent keeps thinking about the door and the idea of ​​blowing it down.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The memory of the lost snake
passages.text:
You sail near the gate that Laurent had destroyed with the Lukran cannon.
“This is where Rafael’s little snake got eaten…” said Laurent in a low voice.
Gloria clicks her tongue.
— He still hasn't recovered. Don’t talk about it, otherwise he’ll start crying again, she whispers.
You pass in front of the gaping entrance that Laurent had opened.

→ Return to the ship.

Deep reds and yellows, rich browns, bright whites, and shades of blue from clear sky to midnight blue adorn the hulls, livening up the harbor like a holiday.
But there is nothing festive about the shore.
Zokmere hunters have pitched their yellowed tents around a campfire, with a row of butchering tables.
Further on, a collection of hanging skins forms a sinister barrier against the jungle.
On the edge of the camp, a miserable pile of cages full of animals squawking, screaming and growling.
Hunter’s Haven is a colorful harbor, inhabited by hunters and their caged animals—a macabre mix of bright colors and the smell of death.

—Did I say that? What a shame... I exchanged it yesterday. But I will honestly pay you for these eggs, they are a real treasure! Here, take some more gold.
“This gold isn’t worth half an artifact,” Mac insists. Where did he go?
“A man with a ship like yours bought it,” replied the hunter.

Like a diplomat welcoming guests to dinner, the monster clears its throat before greeting you:

“I use, of course, the rarest materials known to the thinking races,” he explains proudly.
The hardest to obtain was Shorme's blood crystal.
It is the heart of my work: when the light reaches it at the zenith of the autumn equinox, it will project a sublime radiance on the sea.
You learn that he holds a sacred crystal in the center of his sculpture.
A. Convince him to give you the crystal.
→ 🦊 CUNNING 7
→ Failure: +3 low morale (Tolerating your logorrhea is exhausting.)
→ Go to paragraph 42.3
B. Take it from him by force.
→ 🪓 STRENGTH 6
→ Failure: -5 health (The artist is not strong, but he throws surprisingly sharp tools.)
→ Go to paragraph 42.4

passages.title: The vortex metaphor
passages.text:
You manage to persuade him that another material would better serve his work.
“Maybe you're right,” he finally admitted, his gaze inspired.
Using obsidian, which absorbs light instead of reflecting it, I will create a deeper metaphor for the vortextuality of the industry.
Here, take this crystal. Let him disappear from my sight!
He hands you Shorme's blood crystal, looking theatrical.
📜 Complete quest 85, 📜 Obtain quest 91
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The cry of the betrayed artist
passages.text:
You grab the crystal and walk away without looking back.
Behind you, the Lukran screams, arms outstretched to the sky.
— Nooooo! My vision! How can I finish it now?!
📜 Complete quest 85, 📜 Obtain quest 91
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Burning Island
passages.text:
If you have the keyword ULO, go to 43.3.
There is no shelter on this island.
Every rock and every tree is split by the heat of the sun.
Under your feet, the sand trembles... then explodes:
A mass of giant tentacles rise from the ground, dragging you and your crew toward the fanged maw of an immense sand squid.
A monstrous squid appears under your feet.
A. Fight!
→ ⚔️ COMBAT 67 (Level 14)
→ Go to paragraph 43.2
B. Flee to the ship.
→ 🪓 STRENGTH 6
→ Failure: -3 health
→ Go to paragraph 43.1

passages.title: The desperate flight
passages.text:
The creature dives into the sea and chases your boat.
Its clawed tentacles pierce the surface of the water in all directions.
— To the left! Audrie shouts.
She paddles frantically, pounding at the slimy flesh until the monster finally lets go and disappears into the depths.
You narrowly escape.
Losses: -3 health, +1 weakened
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The remains of the colossus
passages.text:
Bloody tentacles litter the rocks.
Among them, the remains of former victims:
broken boxes, fabrics, corroded weapons.
You grab everything you can before fleeing the beach, fearing that another monster is lurking beneath the sand.
Get:
+1 artifact +1 meat +3 XP
• adventure card 17 (Tattered Cloak of Ulo)
📜 📜 Get the quest 61
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The return of the sand squid
passages.text:
There is no shelter on this island.
Every stone is cracked by the sun, and as soon as you set foot on the sand a wave passes through it.
Giant tentacles immediately spring out, pulling your crew towards the monster's gaping maw.
A. Fight!
→ ⚔️ COMBAT 67 (Level 14)

passages.title: The luxury ship
passages.text:
If you have the keyword LUXURY, go to 44.5.
Gliding like a swan on a glass lake, a splendid luxury liner appears on the horizon.
Its impeccable oak deck reflects the sunlight, and the black hull shines like polished coal.
“They fly the Foxtrot flag,” said Marco.
Looks like they need help with repairs.
The captain of the ship greets you with great reverence.
— Welcome aboard the RMS Achaean, he introduces himself.
We've been stuck here for weeks.
A strange island has driven our passengers and part of the crew crazy.
They ran into the jungle screaming...
We fled, but our engine is out of service, and supplies are running low.
The captain of the Achaean asks you to help him repair his engine.
A. Help them make repairs.
→ CRAFTING 6
→ Failure: -2 boat damage, +1 low morale (During repairs, the Achaean collides with the Manticore.)
→ Go to paragraph 44.3
B. Make them pay for the repairs.
→ 🦊 CUNNING 7
→ Failure: Go to paragraph 44.1
→ Success: Go to paragraph 44.2
C. Let them fend for themselves and look for food instead.
→ 👁️ PERCEPTION 6
→ Failure: -4 health (Jellyfish sting the crew near the shore.)
→ Go to paragraph 44.4

passages.title: The bitter payment
passages.text:
“I have no choice,” the captain concedes, pursing his lips.
But I find your opportunism repugnant.
The Manticore's crew works all day and night, replacing parts, tinkering with the engine, and getting the ship back afloat.
In the morning, you wake up on a deserted bridge:
the Achaean is missing... and so is some of your equipment.
— These bastards stole from us! Audrie exclaims.
“Look, that smoke in the east... It’s probably them,” Kasumi said.
After repairing their ship, the Achaean crew robs you and flees.
Obtain: +6 coins, +1 XP
📜 Obtain the quests 24 and 25 Choose 3 adventure cards (excluding Passengers) and place them in the discarded quests box.
You won't be able to use them again until the book tells you to collect them.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Ingratitude on the open sea
passages.text:
You spend the day and night repairing the Achaean's engine.
At daybreak, the ship is missing, and parts are missing from the Manticore.
—The bastards set us up! plague Audrie.
“And that smoke to the east… it’s probably them,” adds Kasumi.
After helping, the Achaean crew robs you and runs away.
Obtain: +1 coin, +1 XP
📜 Get the quests 24 and 25 Choose 3 adventure cards (excluding Passengers) and put them in the quest discard box.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Harvest from the shore
passages.text:
You take leave of the captain and prefer to explore the coast.
You chop wood and find something to feed the crew.
Obtain: +1 meats or +1 grain, and +1 materials
📜 Get the quest 25
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The quiet beach
passages.text:
You land on a deserted and peaceful beach.
The calm waters teem with plump clams.
You collect a few before leaving.
Obtain: +1 meats
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
If you have the keyword MINE, go to 45.5.
You discover the entrance to an abandoned mine, littered with broken tools and rusty minecarts.
The wind rushes into the tunnel, carrying away the black dust and the taste of metal.
A. Explore the mine.
→ 👁️ PERCEPTION 8
→ Failure: -5 health
→ Go to paragraph 45.6
B. Rest on the nearby beach.
→ Go to paragraph 45.7

passages.title: The gratitude of the miners
passages.text:
The Imps flee into the darkness, and the miners approach, out of breath but relieved.
Their leader, a colossus with calloused hands, extends his hand to you.
—Thank you, strangers. My name is Gum.
Millie is my wife, but she hasn't been here in a long time.
Years ago, we broke through to the Cinder Realm by accident.
The Imps came out by the hundreds... but we continued to dig, despite everything.
You defeated the Imps, and the miners thank you.
A. Tell Gum you don't believe him and take some ore for Millie.
→ Go to paragraph 45.4
B. Believe Gum and recognize his right to the mine.
→ Go to paragraph 45.3

passages.title: The Spoils of the Flames
passages.text:
While the Imps pursue the panicked miners, you take advantage of the chaos to grab a crate of orichalcum and head towards the Manticore.
“They’ll be fine without us,” Rafael murmurs.
Obtain: +1 coin, +2 materials, +1 low morale, +1 XP
📜 Complete quest 21, 📜 Obtain quest 116
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Gum's deal
passages.text:
“You are good people,” Gum said, patting you on the back.
If you are looking for other veins, there is an old mine on the island to the west.
He draws a little plan on a piece of parchment and offers you a few coins for your trouble.
Obtain: +3 coins, +1 materials, +2 XP
📜 Complete quest 21, 📜 Obtain quest 118
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The theft of the ore
passages.text:
Rafael lifts a crate of sparkling orichalcum.
Gum clenches his fists helplessly.
“I suppose we can't stop you,” he said bitterly.
Do you know how many months it took us to collect all this?
You leave without looking back, the precious metal under your arm.
Obtain: +4 coins, +1 materials, +1 low morale, +2 XP
📜 Complete quest 21, 📜 Obtain quest 116
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The mine conflict
passages.text:
Rusty tools, overturned carts, and broken lanterns line the walls of the well.
As you examine a piece of ore, a handful of miners appear from the darkness.
“You're from Pig Ribs, right? asks one of them.
Millie sent you, I bet.
“She says your contract is over,” Mac replies.
— She would say anything! This mine has always belonged to us.
She's the one who's sulking because they refuse to sell her the money.
A sharp growl suddenly resonates:
two imps with obsidian eyes leap from the darkness.
The miners scream and flee in panic.
The miners defend their mine, but Imps attack.
A. Take advantage of the chaos to take ore and escape.
→ 👁️ PERCEPTION 8
→ Failure: -6 health
→ Go to paragraph 45.2
B. Defend minors.
→ ⚔️ COMBAT 33, 35 (Level 13)
→ Go to paragraph 45.1

passages.title: The safe under the crates
passages.text:
The mine is empty except for a few yellow grapefruit-sized spiders crawling along the walls.
Under a pile of old crates, you discover a chest full of silver nuggets.
Obtain: +3 coins, +1 XP
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Poisoned rest
passages.text:
You light a small fire to relax by the water.
But at sunset, a yellow, bloated spider bites you brutally on the arm before fleeing into the sand.
“Lovely place to camp,” Audrie grunts.
Obtain: +1 poison
Remove: 1 fatigue and 1 low morale
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The slimy creature
passages.text:
A large green salamander climbs the hull of the Manticore and sits proudly near the bow.
She spits black, sticky bile at anyone who dares to approach.
It takes hours of patience and a few narrowly avoided bites to push it back into the sea.
Obtain: +1 poison Loss: -1 Order
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The salvation of the talisman
passages.text:
A fat green salamander climbs onto the ship and spits a stream of black bile onto the deck.
But suddenly she sees a crew member carrying the Scorpion Talisman.
The creature bows low, then regurgitates a shiny gold coin before diving into the waves.
A grateful salamander drops a gold coin before disappearing.
Obtain: +1 coin
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The ravaged camp
passages.text:
If you have the keyword FALCON, go to 47.3.
You land on a beach littered with the remains of a destroyed camp.
A tattered tent flaps in the wind, broken boxes pile up, almost all empty.
Under a torn blanket, you discover a strange weapon - a net rifle, still functional.
You find a destroyed encampment and collect an unusual weapon.
Obtain: adventure card 21 (Snipe Rifle)
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
The forest thins to reveal a field of skeletons, their bones broken and scattered across the grass.
Two statues of eyeless women stand above them, silent guardians of a ruined coliseum.
“Don’t disturb them,” Kannan whispers.
But his warning comes too late.
A crack of stone resonates: the statues come to life.
They rush forward, hitting the earth with a colossal fist.
You take refuge with your crew in a small room — too narrow for them — but their blows end up causing the ceiling to collapse.
When the dust settles, you are alive...but buried.
Two living statues have trapped you under the coliseum.
Losses: -2 health

→ Failure: -5 health
→ Go to paragraph 53.1

passages.title: Hunting in the forest
passages.text:
Following the map through a humid forest, you stop in a clearing where light filters through the leaves.
Suddenly, a beetle as big as a cat falls on Gregory's face!
He screams, tears it off and throws it to the ground, but a dull rumble immediately rises from the bushes behind you...
Something is stalking you in the jungle.
⚔️ COMBAT 12, 13 (Level 11)

passages.text:
If you have the keyword SAPPHIRE, go to 48.6.
You anchor in the bay of a jungle-covered island.
As soon as your feet touch the sand, oblivion invades you.
Why did you come here?
Shouldn't you join your friends in the forest?
You are about to enter the bushes when Mac roughly grabs your shoulder.
“This place is cursed,” she said in a harsh voice.
Get back in the boat now.
Obtain: +1 vegetables Draw destiny: if you obtain 14, gain +1 madness
→ Return to the ship.

She improvises earplugs made of red wax and ties everyone with a rope to prevent them from disappearing.
—If one of us loses his mind, we will bring him back by force, you say.
Nobody stays here.
Under the sticky heat, deceptive visions assail you:
a circus tent, a hotel smelling of roasts, then your sick father calling you far away.
You ignore them and continue up to a hill overgrown with vines.
At the top, you discover Captain Meldrum and his men, asleep in the mud.
You find Captain Meldrum and his crew in a deep sleep.

Meldrum recognizes your face — and begs to be accompanied deeper into the jungle.
His men refuse, letting him go alone with you to a sleeper camp.
There, Meldrum hugs a woman in a yellow dress, tears rolling down his face.
You make enough mud to protect the entire camp, and bring them back to the ship.
“I would have done anything to save my wife,” said Meldrum.
But I should never have stolen from you.
Here, take this. You deserve it more than me.

Soon after, they wake up - except Captain Meldrum.
“He’s obsessed,” said the mechanic. Lock him up, we'll never go back there!
—And his wife? protests an old sailor. She's still on the island!

You board, weapon in hand, ready to recover your stolen belongings...
but the cabins are empty, the corridors silent.

“You have shown a kindness that I do not deserve,” he said.

passages.title: The floating artist
passages.text:
On a small boat, a man works on a stretched canvas, painting using fishbone brushes.
His disheveled gray hair is reminiscent of a bird’s nest.
He scratches his head, thoughtful, facing the seascape.
— I am Grosglum the Painter, famous in Lukra for my strange works.
Even the queen has several!
Do you want one?
A. Buy a painting.
→ Pay 1 piece.
→ Go to paragraph 49.1
B. Refuse and leave.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
The cantina, carved into the rock, is cool and dark.
The owner crushes a scorpion with his thumb before serving you.
“You foreigners are weak for these seas,” he grumbles.
Over there, to the southwest, stands a fortress filled with treasures, plundered from ships like yours...
The keeper tells you about a fortress to the south.

passages.text:
The cliffs lining the shore arch like a wave of frozen stone.
Ancient petroglyphs cover the walls.
Mac approaches, focused.
“It’s a map of the neighboring islands,” she said after a long silence.
Look here: a temple or shrine, to the west.
She carefully copies the symbols into her journal.
Mac discovers the location of a sanctuary to the west.

passages.text:
You say the words:
— “Sun in stone and wandering wind. » The ground vibrates.
A stone head lifts, opening two mineral eyes.
— Few know this phrase, said the Oracle.
I am happy to learn that my friend the Tree still lives.
You had to gain his trust for him to tell you my name.
He opens his mouth, dropping a polished pebble, engraved with moving symbols.
—He asked me to give you this.

passages.text:
Every day Jin gets worse and worse.
His arms tremble, his breath becomes short.
“The poison is consuming me, captain,” she whispers.
If I never come home...give this to my father.
She hands you a crumpled letter, her hand already frozen.
You lose Jin. Your crew's morale is plummeting.

• +3 low morale
• Lose the adventure card 6 (Jin)
• Lose the quest 132

passages.title: The cry of the toucan
passages.text:
If you have the keyword GUSTO, go to 51.4.
The jungle resonates with the cries of birds with bright plumage.
Their noise is almost deafening, but you still sink into a damp cave, where a ray of sunlight shines on an enormous toucan perched in a nest of fallen feathers and rotten straw.
His gravelly voice only knows a few awkward words, but you eventually understand his story:
A large predator steals the birds' eggs, and the toucan begs for your help.
You meet a toucan who asks you to find the stolen eggs.
A. Track down the beast and bring back the eggs.
→ 🦊 CUNNING 8
→ Failure: -5 health, +1 low morale (you fall into a nest of burning red ants)
→ Go to paragraph 51.1
B. Search the jungle for useful materials.
→ 👁️ PERCEPTION 6
→ Failure: -2 health (you fall into a hidden pit bristling with sharp stones)
→ Go to paragraph 51.5

passages.title: The Spotted Thief
passages.text:
In a ravine overgrown with vines, you come across the egg thief:
a large purple cat, striped and nervous, which roars before striking with its powerful paws.
You surround him with ropes and make him fall.
The eggs are safe, but the animal struggles, panting.
Kasumi observes him, her gaze darkened.
“He will never get out of there,” she said.
We can't let him die like this.
You hold the eggs and the captured feline. What are you doing ?
A. Leave the cat prisoner.
→ Go to paragraph 51.2
B. Free him.
→ Go to paragraph 51.3

passages.title: The toucan's meal
passages.text:
— A hungry friend is one more mouth to feed!
shouts the toucan when he sees your return.
Without further ado, he greedily swallows the eggs one by one, without even thanking you.
You leave, a little disgusted, but pocket some sparkling stones from the wall of the cave.
The toucan devours the eggs shamelessly.
Obtain: +4 coins, +1 XP
Obtain: quest 27
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The feline’s thanks
passages.text:
Kasumi cuts the cat's bonds with a blow of her wakizashi.
You flee through the ferns as he roars behind you.
The eggs, too heavy, slip from your hands and you tumble down a muddy embankment until you see the sparkling sea.
Suddenly, the cat jumps and lands in front of you.
You expect the worst, but he places a small golden object at your feet: a sparkling statuette.
Then he silently fled into the jungle.
The cat thanks you in its own way before disappearing.
Obtain: +2 vegetables, +1 coin, +1 artifact, +1 XP Effect: -2 low morale
Obtain: quest 27
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The birds’ feast
passages.text:
The jungle rustles with the din of screaming birds.
You discover some lost eggs which you bring back on board.
Obtain: +1 meats
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The lie of the toucan
passages.text:
While searching the thickets, you notice that the birds carefully avoid the cave where the dirty and sated-looking toucan resides.
Maybe the eggs were never stolen...
You discover that the toucan may not be innocent.
Obtain: +1 materials, +1 coin, +1 vegetables
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Cliff Attack
passages.text:
In the cliffs of a tropical island, a troop of monkeys with obsidian-black fur and glowing red eyes descends howling along the vines.
They jump directly onto the deck of the Manticore, observing you for a moment with worrying intelligence...
then, with a single shrill cry, they disperse, opening the crates of provisions and sowing chaos everywhere on board.
Keep the monkeys off the ship!
🪓 STRENGTH 8
→ Failure: -5 health, +1 madness (Monkeys bite and scratch, their rage seems contagious...)
→ Go to paragraph 52.1

references.context: scratch, their rage seems contagious...) → Go to paragraph 52.1

passages.title: The silence after the storm
passages.text:
The last monkey dives into the sea, swimming towards the jungle-covered cliffs.
The deck is littered with debris, ropes and crushed fruit.
Everyone is covered in scratches and bites.
“I hate this place,” Audrie whispers, cleaning a wound on her arm.
The monkeys were repelled, but at what cost.
Effects:
• Audrie: -1 health
• +1 low morale
• +1 XP
• Lose 1 food or 1 material
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The portal stone
passages.text:
You explore the dark passages beneath the collapsed coliseum.
The air is freezing, saturated with humidity and silence.
At the bottom of a shallow pool, a carved stone emits a blue glow through the dark water.
You plunge your hand in: the water freezes you to the bone.
As soon as your fingers touch the stone, a violent shock passes through your body - as if you had grabbed an electric wire.
You fall backwards, panting...but the stone rests in your closed palm.
“So that’s what Anne was looking for before she retired to her cabin,” Mac said with a satisfied smile.
A few hours later, you emerge from the tunnels and return to the Manticore.
You find a totem underground and return to the ship.
Obtain: +4 coins, +2 XP, Adventure map: 38 — Totem: Portal Stone Complete the quest 6.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Raltolde's Spear
passages.text:
You spend hours digging through rubble.
While clearing the stones, something shines under the lamp:
an ornate spear, inlaid with a rock of obsidian in the handle.
“It’s Raltolde’s spear…” Mac whispers.
And this fragment in the hilt… ​​it’s a totem.
You finally emerge from the ruins, bathed in the dying evening light, and reach the coast, exhausted but triumphant.
You discover a buried totem and join the ship.
Obtain: +2 coins, +1 XP, Adventure card: 30 — Totem: Raltolde's Spear Complete the quest 6.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The spoils of Ubzon
passages.text:
Ubzon casually chews on a piece of crunchy centipede leg as you move deeper into the jungle.
The foliage opens onto a clearing saturated with heat and odors.
Between two gnarled trunks, you unearth a hidden cache:
precious materials, game remains, and even a few sparkling pieces.
The jungle has yielded its riches.
Obtain: +2 materials, +2 meats, +2 coins, +2 XP
→ Go to paragraph 162.

passages.title: The wooden bridge and the giant insects
passages.text:
The leaves of the jungle are slimy, and the ground is covered in thick mud.
Ubzon encourages you, his eyes shining:
—The treasure rests in a temple grander than anything you could imagine.
But a gaping flaw cuts your way.
A hollow, rotten trunk serves as a footbridge over the abyss.
You begin to do so, and soon a disturbing crackling sounds in the darkness...
Giant insects burst from the darkness!
Ubzon has led you into the maw of danger.
⚔️ COMBAT: 20, 21 (Level 12)
→ If you win, go to 55.1.

passages.title: The cries of the shore
passages.text:
At the bend of a bay, you see a coastal village, nestled against a pine forest.
Black smoke rises from the roofs, and the wind brings you a distant cry.
“These forests are crawling with rat creatures,” Mac warns, hand on his gun.
The noise intensifies in the distance.
You can see silhouettes running between the flames.
You hear a cry coming from an attacked village.
A. Observe from the safety of the ship.
→ Go to paragraph 61.1
B. Dock at the village quay.
→ Go to paragraph 56.1

passages.text:
Rats as tall as men, with dark, oily fur, run between the huts, armed with crude tools and smoking torches.
The villagers try to defend themselves with wooden axes, while on the edge of the hamlet, other rats dance for joy, setting fire to the straw roofs.
Houses are burning, villagers are fighting, chaos reigns.
A. Run to put out fires.
→ 🪓 STRENGTH 7
→ Failure: -5 health (The rats burn you with their torches and entire sections of burning roofs collapse on the crew.)
→ Go to paragraph 61.2
B. Fight rats in the village square.
→ ⚔️ COMBAT 29, 30, 31 (Level 11)
→ Go to paragraph 61.3
C. Take advantage of the chaos to loot what you can.
→ 👁️ PERCEPTION 5
→ Failure: -3 health (You are not the only one searching the ruins, and rats don't like competition. They attack you while you run away with your arms full.)
→ Go to paragraph 61

passages.title: The nostalgic sailor
passages.text:
🔑 If keyword SUPPLIES, go to paragraph 57.1 Black coal smoke escapes from a small tugboat near the desert coast.
It looks like he's wandered straight from New York Harbor, and the sight makes your heart ache with nostalgia.
A red-faced man greets you, waving his fishing cap, as if he were hailing a taxi on Fifth Avenue.
— Beautiful boat! he shouts.
I spread the word: several ships from the States have figured out how to get home!
There is a meeting around an island to the southeast.
He gives you directions, all the while humming a familiar old sea shanty.
— Above all, don’t forget to bring enough food, it’s our only chance to return!
Then he restarts his engine and disappears behind a cloud of steam and memories.
A man on a tugboat told you about a gathering of ships that had found their way back to New York.
📜 Get the quest 105
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
You discover a lively floating market:
jittery stalls, hanging lanterns, scents of spices and hot metal.
The merchants welcome you with a big smile, praising their wares from the four parts of the sea.
You can do business here.
Draw 5 market cards.
You can buy one or more at a discount of -1 on their cost.
→ Return to the ship.

→ Pay 1 piece → +2 meats, +2 vegetables, return to ship

The employee glances at you nervously, then leans to your ear:
— You don't get this from me, but... there is a second auction house, clandestine, in a bay to the northwest.
The sales there are… very special.
I have the password for their next session.
Maybe… 2 pieces would jog my memory?

I don't know what they will sell this time, but the word is always linked to the rare item being auctioned.

passages.title: The Titanic Fish
passages.text:
A colossal fish bursts from the ocean and crashes onto the deck of the ship with a deafening crash.
Its scaly tail hangs to port, while its massive head rests on the other side, glassy eyes staring into space.
The crew remains frozen for a moment, torn between stupor and panic.
The bridge is bending under the weight of the beast, and the smell of salt and blood is already rising.
A sea monster has descended on your ship. What are you doing ?
A. Push it back into the water.
→ 🪓 STRENGTH 6
→ Failure: Take 2 ship damage.
→ Go to paragraph 202.
B. Skinning the beast for food.
→ Go to paragraph 202.1

passages.text:
The brand new buildings stand among still open construction sites, a symbol of a young, ambitious city, shaped by Lukrane modernity.
In the streets, well-dressed citizens pass you by without a glance—too hasty, too important to linger.
In the center of the large square, rises an immense iron and white stone bell tower, still unfinished, whose giant gears shimmer in the sun.
A buzzing city is under construction.
An unfinished bell tower dominates the main square.

passages.title: The Engineer’s Tower
passages.text:
Workers are busy around the bell tower, transporting pieces of metal and glass.
One of them shows you a small office at the foot of the tower.
Inside, a young Lukran wearing a monocle examines plans with passion.
— Welcome, welcome! he exclaims when he sees you.
You're not from here, am I wrong?
I am Raziz Ven, chief engineer, mayor of Glance, and designer of this mechanical marvel before your eyes.
Needless to say, you've heard of me before.
Mac leans towards you, whispering:
— Indeed, I heard his name. Not sure how talented he is, but his family is richer than the gods themselves.
You meet Raziz Ven, the mayor of Glance, busy designing his monumental clock.
A. Ask him if he needs help (if you don't have the keywords CRYSTAL, MATERIALS or CLOCK) → Go to paragraph 60.2
B. Talk to him about antiques (requires the keyword OWL) → Go to paragraph 60.3

passages.title: The Shormeblood Crystal
passages.text:
“Yes, in truth, I could really use some help,” he said, adjusting his monocle.
I designed an oscillator made of shormeblood, a unique crystal that stabilizes the frequency of a clock.
Unfortunately, it is impossible to obtain one. I need a tiny amount, but without it my masterpiece will remain silent.
Mac crosses his arms.
— Do you have any idea where we could find some?
“Two avenues,” Raziz replies.
A mine in the north, which hasn't delivered anything for weeks, and an artist in the east, an eccentric who would use this crystal for his sculptures.
If you help me, I will reward you generously.
Raziz entrusts you with the quest for the Shormeblood, a rare crystal essential to his clock.
You might be able to find some in the mine to the north or from the artist to the east.
📜 Get the quest 85
→ Back to 60

My father already collected these wonders.
Are you looking for something specific?

This is one of my most precious pieces.
He is the one who inspired my inventions.
I believe it helps me think more clearly.
I won't part with it easily.
Raziz has the owl, but you'll have to convince him.

passages.text:
Raziz examines the crystal under a magnifying glass, fascinated.
- Gorgeous ! Exactly what I needed!
Thanks to you, the Glance clock will beat to the rhythm of the stars themselves.
Come back in two or three years, you will see: it will make history!

Raziz can now continue his work.

passages.title: The Pann letter
passages.text:
You give the letter from the old woman Pann to a hunter dressed in furs.
He reads it at length, then raises his head, grave.
— It’s a letter from my sister Zvari.
She fears that our tribes will divide and tear each other apart.
If war breaks out, we will disappear.
Our empire is dead, our customs are fragile... but there is still hope.
Come with me, we must prevent this conflict.
You meet Zvarm, brother of Zvari, and he asks for your help.
Obtain: Adventure card 5 (Zvarm)
📜 Complete quest 130, 📜 Obtain quest 28
→ Back to 60

passages.title: In search of Vilmus Oleberos
passages.text:
After several questions in the main square, a smiling young woman informs you:
— Oh, the old healer? Yes, he had a store here for a while.
But he hated the noise and the dust.
He left to build a cabin on the neighboring island, to finally have a little peace.
Vilmus Oleberos left Glance to isolate himself on the next island.
📜 Complete quest 70, 📜 Obtain quest 90
→ Return to 60

passages.title: The weight of plunder
passages.text:
— “It’s bad, captain…” Kasumi spits, her eyes hard, refusing to carry the bags of stolen food.
— “You call that survival? I call it theft. » She walks away without another word.
Kasumi: +1 low morale

passages.title: The attack on the raft
passages.text:
As you watch the houses of the village burn, a sound of hitting wood tears you from your torpor.
A small boat is already approaching the Manticore.
Humanoid rats, glistening with grease and armed with torches, jump on board.
Rats are invading your ship!
⚔️ COMBAT: 29, 30, 31 (Level 11)
→ Go to paragraph 61.4

passages.title: Partial rescue
passages.text:
You manage to put out the fires and push the rats back into the forest.
A man dressed in a bloody toga calls out to you, exhausted:
— You arrived in time... but I would have preferred if you helped in the square.
The houses you saved were empty.
Well… you did what you could.
A grateful resident, despite everything.
Obtain: +2 coins, +1 grain
📜 Complete the quest 1 Note: Last Hope is now released!
In the future, you can explore the 63 location to visit the village and talk to the locals.

passages.title: Victorious fight
passages.text:
The remaining rats flee into the forest.
A man dressed in a blood-stained toga walks towards you:

The horizon is empty. Not a sail, not a trace on the sea.

— “Have you lost anything, captain?”
Maybe I can help you find him... if you give me something interesting in return. » 🜂 Your ship is missing, and a mysterious cat is offering help — at a price.

In my Wandering Sea, your crew perished, your ship sank.

“Kill my father. Kill Thrack. And I will give you a totem.
It is found in the southern seas. Be quick — the weather is still stable there. » You want to call him a liar, but the coordinates and the photo identical to yours make your blood run cold.
Maybe he's telling the truth...
Or maybe time itself is playing with you.

passages.title: The Scarlet Rocks
passages.text:
The sea crashes against a deserted coast of red stone.
You take advantage of the stopover to catch a few lobsters before heading back to sea.
🍖 Win 1 meat.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Vessel of Secrets Zokmere
passages.text:
A Zokmere merchant ship drifts gently against the current.
Its sails are painted with soothing symbols, and its sailors weave ropes while humming strange prayers.
The captain, dressed in a coat woven with silver thread, welcomes you with a serene smile:
“Bring us your ancient artifacts, travelers. In exchange, we will share with you the secrets of a peaceful mind. » 💠 Your choices:
A. Offer 1 artifact.
→ Earn 4 coins or 3 food (grain, meat or vegetables),
→ Earn 1 XP,
→ Remove 1 low morale,
→ Discard the adventure card 70 (Insane Song) if you have it.
→ Return to the ship.
B. Offer 2 artifacts.
→ Earn 9 coins and 2 XP,
→ Removes 1 fatigue and 1 low morale,
→ Discard the adventure card 70 (Insane Song) if you have it.
→ Return to the ship.

→ Draw 10 market cards and keep some 1,
→ Earn 3 XP,
→ Removes 3 fatigue and 1 low morale,
→ Discard the adventure card 70 (Insane Song) if you have it.
→ Return to the ship.

→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Stone Staircase and the Ocher Room
passages.text:
You arrive at the foot of a wide staircase carved into the golden rock, glowing under a twilight of embers.
At the top, a shallow chamber provides welcome shelter from the biting sun.
But a dull worry grips you.
Who built this place?
And what remains of those who lived there?
🌄 You discover a chamber dug into the rock.

(Requires the keyword SQUARE) → Go to paragraph 98.2

→ Go to paragraph 94

🏗️ Wins 1 Material.
→ Return to the ship.

A rectangular room opens before you, carved from matte black stone.

You walk endlessly in this blind night.

Maybe it leads to the sea?

passages.text:
The water is freezing and bottomless. Your clothes weigh you down, but the rush of the current ends up carrying you until daylight.
Exhausted, you walk along the coast until you see the familiar silhouette of the Manticore.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
As you search the gray and cracked stumps, your gaze stops on the shine of pure metal:
a silver ax, buried deep in the wood, as if the trunk had grown around it.
At his feet rests an old wooden chest, cracked by time but still sealed.
You open it — inside, old pieces glow faintly beneath the dust.
💰 Rewards:
• Win 3 coins,
• Earn 1 XP,
• Win the adventure card 72 (Silver Axe),
• Obtain the quest 166.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
🔑 If keyword TOAD, go to paragraph 101.3
🔑 If keyword BICYCLE, go to paragraph 102.2 No one is really enthusiastic about venturing into this stifling jungle, where every leaf seems to ooze heat.
But you eventually discover a stone path hidden under the moss, leading to a cabin perched in a colossal tree.
Inside, a dusty suitcase lies next to a sitting skeleton, as if it had waited motionless for years to die.
You open the chest and discover a little forgotten treasure.
🎁 Rewards:
• Gain 2 Artifacts
• Earn 1 XP
• Get the quest 117
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Escape Under the Rock Ledge
passages.text:
You rush under a stone arch, trying to hide from the roaring dinosaur.
The animal sniffs, scratches the earth, then finally moves away, its heavy steps making the ground vibrate.
Coming out of your hiding place, your eyes meet a nest of sparkling blue eggs.
— “It’s here! » Rafael exclaims, his eyes shining.
— “Silence, idiot, do you want him to come back?!” » Kannan whispers, furious.
You collect the eggs and return to the ship, your heart still beating.
🎁 Rewards:
• Earn 2 Materials, 1 Vegetable, 2 XP
• Complete the quest 142 and win the quest 145
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Fight against the Fin Lizard
passages.text:
The spiny lizard collapses in a large cloud of dust.
You search the surroundings and discover a nest of blue eggs under a rock ledge.
— “It’s them!” » exclaims Rafael, excited.
After securing the precious find, you return to the ship, burdened and exhausted.
🎁 Rewards:
• Gain 2 Materials, 3 Meats, 3 XP
• Complete the quest 142 and win the quest 145
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:

Mac examines a scribbled map of the Zokmere fighter before setting off.
Insects abound — centipedes as big as arms, spiders hanging from shiny threads.
A group of monkeys with red eyes and obsidian manes observe your progress.
As fatigue sets in, the earth suddenly trembles:
a huge crested lizard, similar to a terrestrial sailfish, emerges from the vegetation.
⚔️ Choice:

→ ⚔️ COMBAT 66, 71 (Level 14) — Go to paragraph 101.2

Failure: Lose 4 Health, gain 2 Fear.
→ Go to paragraph 101.1

passages.title: The Careful Rescue
passages.text:
You methodically disassemble the wreckage, freeing Lyla from the rubble without aggravating her injuries.

passages.text:
The climb is steep.

passages.text:
You dive into the underground river.
The icy water grabs you, pulls you downstream. Your boots and your bag weigh you down, but you don't give up.
Finally, a burst of light!
You spring into the foam and return to the coast, panting, soaked... but free.

Robust men and women bustle about, each holding a gleaming axe.

passages.text:
The forest is thicker than expected, despite the massive logging visible from the shore.
Even with all their axes, the loggers of Lynn’s Grove only scratched the surface.
After a long walk, you take a break.
That’s when Gregory calls you:
— “Captain!” Looks like someone forgot something! » Under a stump, he found a wooden trunk, with a label attached by a string.
Mac deciphers it:
— “If found, please return to Ess Zassi: small rocky island near Lynn’s Grove. » 🎁 Discovery: a chest to return to its owner.

— “Garlen, to serve you!” » He leads you through the modest rooms, lined with sculpted artifacts.
— “In ancient times, the gods lived here before falling into their sleep. Then came the Pann Empire… also disappeared. Lynn’s Grove is very new — I was already wrinkled when we built these walls! » Garlen takes a furtive glance, then invites you to come closer:
— “Everything here is new, you see? Even the trees. They look old, but they are not.
If you want to know why… check out the Pillar of Kemter. » 🧭 Garlen tells you that the trees in Lynn's Grove are not natural.
→ New place of interest: Kemter Pillar.

passages.title: The Depths of the Silent Sea
passages.text:
You put on the old Lukrane diving suit, attach the air pump and slowly submerge.
The water envelops you in its viscous silence.
The only light comes from the pale reflections of the waves above you.
Your pulse accelerates.
Instinct screams at you to go back up — but you breathe in slowly, controlling your fear.
Soon, the luminous halo intensifies.
Your boots sink into the sand of the seabed, and you move towards the source.
Before you stands a colossal statue of a woman, holding a spherical lantern.
Her hair, made of petrified snakes, is covered in algae and shells, but her face — smooth, intact, almost alive — seems to stare at you through the black water.
Suddenly, a gigantic shadow passes between you and the statue.
A shark.
Your survival instinct is screaming.
⚖️ Choice:
A. Take the lantern. → Go to paragraph 221
B. Leave the lantern and search around the statue. → Go to paragraph 221.1

the blue sky stretches above you, vast and bright after so much darkness.
In front of you, on the wet sand, a sparkling pile of gold coins awaits you.
The reward for finding the exit...

passages.text:
— “Are you sure, Captain? » Audrie asks, hesitant.
She goes back to her cabin and comes back with an old acoustic guitar with chipped varnish.
— “I'm a little rusty, but I'll try. » She clears her throat and sings an old popular ballad.
As she sings, the walls of the pillar glow dimly, vibrating to the rhythm of the chords.
But with the last note, the light goes out... and silence falls again.
— “Sorry, Captain. It probably wasn't the right song. » 🎵 Audrie's singing briefly awakens the pillar before the light fades.
💫 Effect: –1 Low morale
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Manticore Choir
passages.text:
You have been rehearsing together for weeks.
Rafael sings out of tune, Kannan has a surprisingly clear voice, and Audrie provides guitar accompaniment.
When the first notes rise, the base of the pillar ignites with white light.
A stone pier slowly emerges from the waves, streaming with foam.
Then an engraved door takes shape in the wall and sinks silently.
— “Captain… it works! » marvels Audrie.
But in the distance, the sea is agitated: massive shapes emerge from the depths, attracted by the song.
⚔️ Sea monsters are approaching!

passages.title: Meecra's Guitar
passages.text:
Behind the door is a large atrium, lit by skylight openings.
The ceiling and walls are covered with an unknown sky map, whose constellations do not belong to any known world.
A staircase leads to a large carved door.
— “Locked!” » moans Rafael.
— “Maybe if some people sang in tune, Meecra would open for us,” Gregory teases.
But suddenly, Mac exclaims:
— “Look!” Down ! » A column emerges from the ground in the center of the room, revealing a pedestal on which rests a guitar decorated with painted flowers.
Audrie approaches with emotion, grabs it and whispers:
— “She’s beautiful…” 🎁 Reward: +1 XP, 86 Adventure Card (Totem:
Meecra's Guitar) ✅ Quest 54 completed

passages.title: The Gruff Hermit
passages.text:
A gruff voice screams from inside:

— “But have some zucchini on the porch.
I have way too many, and no one wants them! » You let out a smile.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Vilmus Oleberos
passages.text:
A dry voice rang out:
— “Go!” » But Gregory comes forward.
— “Vilmus Oleberos?” I am a ship's doctor. I was told that you know the recipe for Lukran medicinal balm, the one that heals wounds incredibly quickly. I wish I could learn it — it could save so many lives. » A long silence, then the door opens.
A stocky old man with a salt-and-pepper beard observes you with a somber look.
— “Come in, then. » He leads you into a small living room with soft blue armchairs, then sits down with a sigh.
— “I am retired. I no longer practice. Why should I teach you anything? » ⚖️ Choice:
A. Encourage Gregory to demonstrate his medical knowledge.
🧠 CONNAISSANCE 5
Failure: Gregory wins +1 Low morale → Go to paragraph 129.3

🦊 🦊 CUNNING 5

passages.title: The Wounds of the Past
passages.text:
Vilmus listens silently to tales of Gregory's medical prowess.
Then he calmly asks:
— “If you are so good, why do you need my remedy? » Gregory looks down.
— “Because, despite all my knowledge, I could not…” His voice trembles.
“…I couldn’t save my little girl. That's why I left my office. I boarded a ship to escape, but I don't want to flee anymore. If I can prevent others from experiencing what I experienced, I must learn. » The old man looks away towards the window.
A long moment passes.
Then, in a tired voice:
— “I left medicine for the same reason. Alright.
Wait here. I'll look for the recipe. » You place a comforting hand on Gregory’s shoulder. He gives you a weak smile.
🎁 Reward: Adventure Card 63 (Lukran Medicinal Balm) ✅ Quest 90 completed.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Two Men, One Scar
passages.text:
At first, Vilmus remains closed off, but Gregory's words touch him.
The old man finally sighed.
— “I had a young protégé in Glance. Brilliant boy. He fell ill, and all my knowledge was not enough. I no longer had the strength to continue. » Gregory nods slowly.
- " I understand. I experienced the same thing… my daughter…” His voice breaks.
— “I left my practice to escape this pain. But if I had known... if I could learn something to avoid this tragedy for others... then I want to learn it. » Vilmus observes him for a long time.
— “You are braver than I was. Alright. I'll teach you the recipe. Wait here. » 🎁 Reward: Adventure Card 63 (Lukran Medicinal Balm) ✅ Quest 90 completed.
→ Return to the ship.

A drumbeat vibrates the floor, and your crew laughs for the first time in days.

The dials click into place with a mechanical click.
You take a step back...
Nothing happens.
The stone door remains closed.

The heavy door is engraved with a system of three dials, each displaying a number from 0 to 9.
All around, on the four walls, enigmatic sentences are written:
“You need to TRI-open the answer.” » “Countdown or forward, for pain or pleasure. » “Zero is nothingness. » “One is not enough. » 🌀 You need to enter a three-digit combination.
✍️ Note a three-digit number.

— “Welcome to my auction house. You can simply call me the Master of Ceremonies. Here, we respect two virtues: discretion and efficiency.
Let's get started. » His assistant — the man with the lantern — enters, carrying an ornate box.
— “Inside, a unique artifact: the bones of the great god Valard, master of war and vengeance. More precisely, the right toe lost during his duel with the hero Raltolde. » The assistant opens the box: inside, a few fragments of white bone, polished by time.
— “Let the auctions begin. » ⚖️ Choice:

B. Bid 7 pieces. (Pay 7) → Go to paragraph 132.10

passages.title: The Manticore?
passages.text:
The ship's gutted hull floats half submerged, charred by salt and time.

You explore the collapsed deck, the ripped holds - until you come across a corpse in a storage chest.
His uniform is identical to yours.
Same badge. Same seal.
And on a soggy tablet, a photograph shows your entire crew... long dead.
An icy cold runs through your limbs.
Nobody speaks.
Even Mac, usually rational, can't find any words.
“Let’s go, Captain. Right away. » ☠️ The evidence is undeniable — this ship full of corpses is, one way or another, the Manticore.

In the shallow waters, you notice a bronze bell hanging from a wooden stake.
A sign nailed to it bears this inscription:
“If you are here to bring me my trunk, ring the bell once and only once — Ess Zassi. »

→ Go to paragraph 137.2

passages.title: The Punishment of the Bell
passages.text:
The bell rings much louder than expected.
The sound travels through your bones, making your teeth vibrate.
By the second ring, the pain becomes unbearable — each wave is like a hammer to your skull.
You fall to your knees.
Suddenly, a woman emerges from the sea, holding the bell to stop it.
Her shiny green hair waves like seaweed.
“The sign said only once!” » she growls.
“You could have killed yourself!” …Wait…is that my trunk? » She softens.
“Very well, I’ll give it up. You have done me a great service.
But I want to reward you. What would you like? » 💀 -3 Health.
You're suffering, but you attracted Ess Zassi.
Choose:
A. Request pearls → Go to paragraph 137.4
B. Ask for the contents of the trunk → Go to paragraph 137.5
C. Ask for the bell → Go to paragraph 137.6

passages.title: The Underwater Creature
passages.text:
The diving suit is ready, and you dive into the dark depths.
The world becomes silence and darkness, barely disturbed by strange lights in the abyss.
There, a titanic shape emerges from the black: an iron submersible, profiled like a giant snail, bristling with rusty spikes and illuminated by two round portholes like eyes.
You raise your hand in friendship...
But the steel creature jumped. A mechanical tentacle grabs you and sucks you into its docking bay.
Four Lukran sailors tear off your helmet.
A woman with braided brown hair comes forward, wearing a blue coat with marine reflections.
“A spy!” » she spits.
A. “We’re just looking for a way home.”
→ Go to paragraph 138.2
B. “We seek allies to destroy the gods.”
→ Go to paragraph 138.1

The woman arches an eyebrow, a flash of interest in her eyes.
“Your ambition intrigues me. » She takes out a folded card, draws a symbol in black ink, then hands it to you.
“I am Captain Gala.
One of mine is a prisoner there.
Join us there, and get ready to fight.
You won't regret it. » The snail submersible slowly rises to the surface, and you are at the Manticore.
Audrie watches the machine move away, fascinated:
“What an engineering marvel…” ⚓ Earn 2 XP

passages.title: Thrown into the sea
passages.text:
“You think I’ll take pity on you because you want to go home? » “If you are ready to wake the gods, then flee. You don't deserve anything. » The woman turns away with contempt.
“Throw that totem raider into the sea!” » The sailors violently put your helmet back on you and threw you out of the airlock.
Underwater, you struggle, taking with you some fragments torn from the submarine.
The iron snail disappears into the abyss.
By inspecting the debris, you discover Lukrane pieces of great finesse.
⚙️ Earn 6 coins, 2 XP and the 33 adventure card (Lukran Mechanical Arm)
📜 Get the quest 151

passages.title: The Specter Necklace
passages.text:
The specter stares at you blankly, but its smile seems almost human.
“We always want to go home… even when it’s not good for us. » His voice grows colder, echoing through the stone.
" Either. If that is your decision, I will not help you.
Awaken the gods, and they will regain all their power.
Then, this archipelago will experience even greater misfortune.
— Now disappear! » A spectral scream tears through the air, and everything around you collapses.
The walls are collapsing, the slabs are exploding, the earth is shaking.
Blocks of stone fall in deadly rain.
Amidst the chaos, Rafael leaps forward, grabbing the specter's neck and tearing off its glittering necklace before falling back to your side.
You flee towards the Manticore, covered in dust, your heart pounding.
“Not a total loss, at least,” Rafael laughed, twirling the jewelry.
“Let’s get out of here now,” Audrie responds, still shaking.
💀 The ghost has destroyed the room, but you narrowly escape.
🎁 Rafael stole the specter's necklace.

passages.title: The Escape
passages.text:
You return to the deck of the Manticore, panting and your arms full of loot.
But barely have you cast off when a roar shakes the bay.
On the beach, the betrayed bride and groom pulled out a cannon from who knows where — perhaps hidden under the wedding tent.
The troupe, always dressed in silk and garlands, bombards you with surreal chaos.
“Where the hell did this weapon come from?!” » Gregory shouts as he maneuvers the tiller.
A ball hits the stern, splitting the wood and tearing off a railing.
You manage to flee out of range of the shots, leaving behind the furious screams and burning ribbons.
💥 Take 2 damage to the ship.
💰 Gain 2 coins, 1 grain and 1 material.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Fist of Stone
passages.text:
The abyss opens beneath your slow steps.
In the light of your lamp, you can see a stone hand raised from the sand, its fingers clenched around an iridescent crystal amulet.
The pendant pulses like a sleeping heart.
"Beautiful...but scary," Mac whispers through the suit's communicator.
You detach the jewel before returning to the surface, the light gradually dissipating behind you.

passages.title: The Seed
passages.text:
You pick up the seed, and immediately a living warmth spreads in your palm.
Beneath your feet, the ground vibrates.
Around you, the trees quiver, and a low rumble rises from the depths of the forest.
“Something is coming…” Kasumi warns, hand on her weapon.
The ground shakes more — it's not roots, but footsteps. Massive. Elders. Angry.
⚔️ COMBAT 43, 44, 45 (Level 17)

passages.text:
Rather than give in to temptation, you fill in the earth above the seed, swearing that no hand will desecrate it.
A gentle wind runs through the forest, like a silent thank you.
You leave empty-handed, but with a peaceful soul: life here will prosper.
🌱 Quest 62 completed.

passages.title: The Forest Dies a Little More
passages.text:
As the Manticore sails away, you take one last look at the coast.
The trees already look duller, the leaves paler
— as if the forest had lost part of its soul.
But you know that this seed brings you closer to your goal.

passages.title: The Cave
passages.text:
The sea breeze rushes into the cavern, mixed with the roar of the waves.
In front of you, the opening opens onto the void: a steep drop of around twenty feet towards the sea below.
You move forward carefully... when a low rumble shakes the ground.
The walls vibrate, cracks streak the rock — then everything collapses.
“It’s collapsing!” Jump! » shouts Gregory.
Without thinking, you plunge into the void as the cavern crashes behind you with a titanic crash.
The icy water envelops you, but you surface safely, panting, the Manticore visible in the distance.
🌊 You escaped the landslide.
🗺️ Get the quest 154.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:

Gregory carefully collects some of the corrosive liquid into a vial.
“We can use it, Captain!” » he says, turning the bottle in his hands.
⚓ The Manticore pitches, its planks smoking with acid.
💥 Suffered 1 damage to the ship.
💎 Gain the adventure card 60 — Flask of Acid.
→ Return to the ship.

In a dilapidated house outside the village, you find the woman you were looking for.
Her brown skin glows under a purple velvet cape, and her eyes are filled with a strange melancholy.
“Thank you…” she whispers, lowering her hood.
Under the pale light, you discover the horror: an enormous black scorpion stuck in his skull, its sting stuck between his temples.
She then raises a sparkling crystal, and the beast detaches itself, gripping the gem in its pincers before disappearing in thick yellow smoke.
At this moment, Jin coughs violently: the same smoke escapes from his lungs.
“See?” I didn’t mean to hurt you,” the woman said in a trembling voice.
“As long as you were contaminated by its venom, I could neither speak nor act. Thank you for your courage. » She offers you everything she has, but you only accept a small part, out of respect.

passages.text:

“Thank you very much. This treasure is worth a fortune! » Audrie protests:
“You had to destroy it!” » “I said a lot of things,” he sneers. “But why destroy what can enrich us? » Mac frowns:
“Zacra… the god of prisoners, money and deception. » Zoy bursts out laughing:
“Excellent!” So you know our master. For your help, I offer you knowledge: the means to open the Pillar of Zacra. » 🎭 The pilgrims are actually worshipers of Zacra, god of deception, and will sell the book to get rich.
📘 Lose the adventure card 65 — Gomka.
📜 Complete the quest 53 and win the quests 55 and 58.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Refusal of Blasphemy
passages.text:
Zoy growls, his face contorting in anger.
“How dare you challenge the high priest of Zacra? » Mac responds, icily:
“Zacra… god of prisoners, money and deception. » “And money!” » Zoy spits. “This book is worth a fortune. If you don't give it to us, we'll take it from you! »
⚔️ The priests of Zacra attack to seize the book.
⚔️ COMBAT 76, 77, 78 (Level 18)
→ Go to paragraph 149.9

passages.title: The Title of High Priest
passages.text:
You defeat the pilgrims and bind them with their own chains.
Zoy laughs weakly:
“You have fooled us… true disciples of Zacra. Come on, take my title of high priest too! »
💰 Earn 3 coins.
💎 Gain 1 artifact.
📜 Complete the quest 53 and win the quest 58.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Giant Bone Docks
passages.text:
➡️ If the keyword NUGGET is present, go to 150.5.
➡️ If the keyword IMP is present, go to 150.4.
➡️ If the keyword MUSHROOM is present, go to 150.6.
Along the coast, immense petrified leviathan ribs form the backbone of a city built between sea and skeleton.
Wooden platforms sink between the titanic bones, and thatched roofs cling to the sides of the carcasses.
The name of the place? Pig Ribs — a haunt of sailors, prospectors and smugglers.
🌊 Rowboats creak in the salty wind.
Hand-painted signs read: Saloon, Appraisal Office, Herbalist, and Lokrim’s Artifacts.
A. Visit the saloon.
💰 Pay 1 piece. → Go to paragraph 150.1
B. Visit the appraisal office. → Go to paragraph 150.2
C. Visit Lokrim’s Artifacts. (Requires the keyword MILK) → Go to paragraph 150.3
D. Visit the herbalist. (Requires the keyword POISON) → Go to paragraph 150.7
E. Leave town. → Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Saloon of the Coasts
passages.text:
The air is saturated with sweat, tobacco and cheap rum.
Around you, sailors laugh while a toothless old man tells a legend.
“The island to the north… it is said to be cursed by the gods.
In the past, the Pann people defied the sky there. Since then, lightning has never stopped falling. Everyone who ventures there disappears. » A young sailor sneers:
“Yeah, he’s probably hiding his treasure there, the old fool!” » ⚡ You learn of the existence of an island cursed by the eternal storms of the gods.
📜 Get the quest 20.
→ Return to Pig Ribs.

passages.text:
🔑 If keyword IMP, go to paragraph 150.4 A one-eyed woman examines pieces of rock with a magnifying glass, absent-mindedly licking one.
“Are you looking for work? I have an orichalcum mine on the south coast. I sent miners there, but these dogs have taken control and refuse to deliver the ore to me.
I want to recover what belongs to me, through negotiation...
or otherwise. » 💎 She tasks you with taking back the orichalcum ore.
📜 Get the quest 21.
→ Return to Pig Ribs.

An old woman examines you suspiciously.
“Were you poisoned?” I can remove the venom...
for a price. »

passages.title: The village of the chapel
passages.text:
The rocky coast is dominated by a church steeple rising into the icy blue sky. A few modest houses surround the building.
Marco remains frozen:
“A strangely familiar sight in a world that is not. » A woman sees your group and runs towards you – more precisely, towards Marco:
“Father!” she exclaims. Come in! » 🌊 You discover a small community gathered around a church built on a stony shore.
A. Enter the church.

B. Leave.
→ Return to the ship.

“No hard feelings, Padre, but I think I'll wait outside. I'm not really the type to go to masses. » Leaving Gregory outside, you enter the church.
The place is beautifully built, illuminated by abstract stained glass windows in shimmering colors.
A man—obviously a notable—comes to meet you and shakes Marco's hand.
“Welcome, Father!” And welcome to your companions too. » You notice that Marco is the only one here wearing a priest's collar.

passages.title: The lost architects
passages.text:
Marco and the man speak at length in Spanish.
Then Marco sums it up for you:
“This man is Ricardo Perez. These people are mostly architects from our world. Their cruise ship was transported here.
Not suited for adventure, they chose to settle rather than seek out totems. But they struggle to survive:
none have agricultural or fishing skills.
They ask us, if we come across farmers or fishermen, to direct them here. » Ricardo nods:
“We will gladly welcome them — only if they want to, of course. » 🏗️ These architects from your world have chosen to settle here, but they lack workers capable of producing food.
📜 Win the quest 73.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Gregory's doubts
passages.text:
You find Gregory outside, leaning against the stone wall, staring into the sky.
“You want to know why I’m not coming in? » he said.
He smiles, without joy.
“I don’t really believe in gods anymore. Not since my daughter. And those of this world are worse than anything. They are not divine... just beings too powerful for their own good.
» He shrugs.
“Marco is a good man. I don't blame him for his faith
— as long as he doesn’t blame me for my lack of faith. » 💬 You discuss with Gregory his rejection of the gods.
→ Returns to 151.1

passages.title: A thriving community
passages.text:
“They are true benefactors! » exclaims Ricardo.
“Thanks to Fara, we learned to fish in this region. Today, we eat our fill, and even better: we trade with our neighbors! » Marco checks in on the residents, including some recently arrived Tinns.
Before you leave, Ricardo holds him back:
“Father, would you agree to stay with us? We don't have a priest. Your presence would be a blessing. » Marco shakes his head sadly.
“My mission is first and foremost with the crew of the Manticore. I can't stop yet. » Ricardo smiles kindly.
“You will always be welcome here. » Leaving the church, Marco joins Gregory outside and taps him twice on the shoulder:
“Come on, friend. Help me prepare these fish for dinner. » 🐟 The village has prospered since the arrival of the Tinn.
🍖 Earn 1 meat.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The rumbling under the trees
passages.text:
You pick up the seed: it is warm in your hand.
Suddenly, a roar shakes the forest. Heavy footsteps echo through the ground, vibrating through your chest.
Raphael grabs Erall by the collar:
“What the hell is that?!” » Erall smiled bitterly.
“It’s your fault, not mine. » He frees himself from Raphael's grip and flees into the woods.
⚔️ COMBAT 43, 44, 45 (Level 17)
→ Go to paragraph 152.2

passages.title: Erall’s gratitude
passages.text:
“The gods may not bless you for this, but the people of Lynn’s Grove will be forever grateful,” Erall said.
You try to refuse the reward, but he insists:
“I’ll get that money back soon, thanks to you.” » 🌿 You leave empty-handed, but the forest — and those who live there — will thrive with your help.
💰 Earn 2 coins.
📜 Complete the quest 62.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The seed of life
passages.text:
As you leave the forest, an eerie silence settles behind you.
The ground already seems less green, the trees duller, the air heavier.
But in your hand lies the fruit of your victory: the sacred seed.
🌱 You carry with you an ancient power, but the forest pays the price.
💰 Earn 4 coins, 1 vegetable, 1 material, 3 XP.
🪶 Win the adventure card 32 (Seed of Life).
📜 Complete the quest 62.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The stone chest
passages.text:
In a wooden chest wrapped in calfskin, you discover a stone carved with strange symbols.
Without missing a beat, you turn back through the underground maze, while the tunnels collapse with a deafening crash behind you.
🪨 You narrowly escape with your precious artifact.
🎴 Win the adventure card 59 (Totem: Gluttony Stone).
📜 Win the quest 154.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The difficult choice
passages.text:
“We can't give up this totem, Jin. This may be our only hope of returning home. Don't worry, we'll find another way to treat you. » But Jin shakes his head, his eyes moist, inconsolable.
Mac intervenes gently:
“I know an herbalist down south…maybe she could help us.” » You decide to keep the totem and return to the ship, the atmosphere heavy with tension.
💎 You keep the totem, despite Jin's grief.
💰 Earn 7 coins, 1 material, 2 low morale points, 4 XP.
🎴 Win the adventure card 69 (Totem: Ohmlude Crystal).

From the bow of the Manticore, you scan the sea, searching for a sign of your prey. The Sail Rust sails to starboard, its sails stretched in the frigid air. The sea is supernaturally calm — too perfect, too smooth.
Suddenly, something breaks through the surface, then immediately disappears.
A moment later, a scream rings out: the Sail Rust is being attacked by a monstrous creature—a stone squid, living like an animated statue! Before you can even intervene, your own ship is rocked by a titanic shock.

A young man named Erall agrees to help you, but he leads you directly to the place where the seed is hidden.
“We all know where she is,” he explains. “It’s an open secret.
It would be bearable if the old man at the museum stopped talking about it to strangers.
Now that you have seen her, I beg you to leave her alone. » “And why show it to us, then?” » asks Gregory.
“Because I knew you two would look for her alone. At least this way I can plead our case.
Without the seed, our trees would stop growing as quickly, and our entire village would slowly die.
I can give you a little money – a little, of course – but the seed is priceless. »
A. Take the seed anyway.
→ 152
B. Leave the seed.
→ 152.1

passages.title: The Gaze of the Forest
passages.text:
You recover your fallen trunk, ready to leave.
But a doubt grips you:
turning your back on the forest seems more worrying to you than going deeper into it.
The trees, silent, watch you leave.
🌲 Wins 2 Materials.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.text:
If you have the keyword FOUGHT → 166.2 Off the coast of a small island, a ship is attacked by a titanic sea creature.
Its tentacles wrap around the shell, pulling it towards the depths.
A. Rescue the ship.
→ 166.3
B. Continue your journey.
→ 166.4

passages.title: The Miraculous Balm
passages.text:
After the battle, the captain of the rescued ship — a tall Lukran with dark skin and bright eyes — greets you in a loud voice:
“Thank you for your help!” Let us return the favor. We have a medicinal ointment that could help your injured people. » You let them come on board, and their care works miracles: the wounds close almost immediately.
Gregory, stunned, grabbed one of the sailors by the shoulders:
“Where does this medicine come from? Who gave it to you?! » “From a healer in Aurora,” the man replies. “I don’t know what’s in it, but it works. » Gregory's gaze hardened.
“Aurora…” he murmurs, thoughtfully.
Lukran adds:
“His shop is well hidden. If you're looking to find it, I can show you the way. This is the minimum after what you have done for us. » 💧 Sailors share an exceptional remedy from Aurora. Gregory seems to see it as more than just a balm.
❤️ Heals 1 health point for each crew member.
💰 Earn 2 coins.
📜 Win the quests 68 and 69.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Calm Seas, Peaceful Sailing
passages.text:
You go along the coast without meeting a single soul.
The wind is gentle and the sea is almost supernaturally calm.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Battle of the Tentacles
passages.text:
As you approach to help, two monstrous tentacles leave the attacked ship and rush towards the Manticore.
“It saves us from having to go looking for them!” » Kasumi shouts, brandishing her weapon.
⚔️ COMBAT: 51, 52
→ 166.1

passages.title: The Cautious Choice
passages.text:
You stay the course at a distance, bypassing the combat zone.
Behind you, Gregory shouts:
“Look!” » In the distance, the besieged ship is swallowed up by the waves, grabbed by immense tentacles.
💔 Lose 1 Morale.
📜 Get the quest 69.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Mysterious Cargo
passages.text:
You load the unmarked crates on board while Thoazak paces the deck of the Manticore, a wide smile on his lips.
“Magnificent ship, yes... a real gem,” he said, tapping the rail with a satisfied air.
💰 Win 1 coin.
📜 Win the quests 111 and 112.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Snakes' Feast
passages.text:
When Thoazak understands what you are doing, he flies into a rage, throwing blows and insults.
But you have it under control, and nothing can prevent him from seeing his crates loaded by force on board.
“You’re going to regret this…” he spits, his smile evil, his teeth red with blood.
As soon as the boilers are turned back on, a howl tears through the air from the hold.
You run downstairs — the crates are open.
Hundreds of snakes, of all sizes, spread like living black oil, seeping into cracks, pipes, chests, and pursuing the terrified sailors.
It takes almost an entire day to capture or kill the majority of them, and additional days to dislodge others, hidden in food crates, pipes, or... beds.
💰 Earn 2 coins.
🍖 Win 2 meats.
☠️ Win 3 Low morale.
🧪 Wins 2 Venoms.
⭐ Earn 2 XP.
📜 Get the quest 111.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Mac's Catch
passages.text:
Mac manages to catch a nice quantity of catfish.
Their fatty and tender flesh delights the crew.
🍖 Win 2 meats.
💪 Withdraw 1 Low morale.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: The Difficult Escape
passages.text:
It still takes several days to get you out of this damn place.
When you finally reach the Manticore, exhausted, hungry, covered in mud and in rags, deliverance mixes with weariness.
The Zokmere woman who helped you escape introduces herself:
“My name is Mei. My husband was a researcher... he disappeared years ago.
Ubzon had convinced me that I would find him here. » You know that without her, you would never have survived this escape, and you naturally ask her to join your crew.
❤️ -6 Cheers.
💔 Win 2 Low morale.
⭐ Earn 2 XP.
💳 Win the Adventure card 49 (Mei).
📜 Lose the quest 15.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Escape Through Cunning
passages.text:
With a button, a shoelace and a piece of bone, you manage to force the locks on your chains, then on the cell.
You run away into the jungle before anyone notices your absence.
The Zokmere woman introduces herself:
“My name is Mei. My husband was a researcher... he disappeared years ago.
Ubzon told me I would find him here. » Grateful for his help, you invite him to board the Manticore.
❤️ -2 Cheers.
💰 Earn 3 coins.
💔 Win 1 Low morale.
⭐ Earn 2 XP.
💳 Win the Adventure card 49 (Mei).
📜 Lose the quest 15.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: Escape Through Strength
passages.text:
You manage to convince the guard to open the cell.
At that moment, Rafael leaps from the shadows, tackles him to the ground and knocks him out with a sharp blow.
You take his keys, free the others, and rush into the jungle before the alarm is given.
The Zokmere woman introduces herself:
“My name is Mei. My husband was a researcher... he disappeared years ago.
Ubzon had convinced me that I would find him here. » You ask him to join your crew, grateful for his bravery.
❤️ -2 Cheers.
💰 Earn 4 coins.
💔 Win 1 Low morale.
⭐ Earn 2 XP.
💳 Win the Adventure card 49 (Mei).
📜 Lose the quest 15.
→ Return to the ship.

passages.title: A Chance Discovery
passages.text:
You draw cards from the Market deck until you reveal a card whose cost is 5 coins or less.
You keep it and put the rest back at the bottom of the deck.
📜 Get the quest 106.

passages.text:
As you slide along the passage, a sharp stone cuts your leg deeply.
You manage to go back up, panting, towards the main room...
but with empty pockets and a bruised body.

A soft, disturbing song fills the air, but you can't find its source.
